text:
sam: FYI customer org 'org-azure-921' says their free trial credits jumped from 1000 to 12 yesterday after a retry storm, now dashboard shows ~0 remaining.
maya: can you paste org id, customer email, and a link to their billing page?
sam: org: org-azure-921, user: liz@acme.co, billing link: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/org-azure-921/billing
sam: they reported 404s on API at ~2026-02-27T23:58:14Z and then a bunch of retries from their client\.
noah: did we see any metering spikes? idempotency keys? logs?
credits-bot: usage alert: org-azure-921 token-charge spike 2026-02-27 23:58 -> 00:03 UTC, +11,200 tokens
maya: interesting — dashboard shows free_credits_remaining: 0, but invoices table shows promo_applied: 1000 credits
alex: invoice snapshot pulled at 2026-02-28T00:00:00Z; promo TTL expiry scheduled at that exact second. I suspect the expiry cron ran before last-minute ledger adjustments.
liz: assigning to eng to confirm whether metering and cron overlap. @noah can you reproduce with test env?
noah: repro steps I used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-test-XXX\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd/gpt-infer-1\",\"input\":\"x\"}'
```
send 500 concurrent requests with 3s retry backoff -> we see repeated token charges due to missing idempotency-key header
noah: log snippet:
```
[2026-02-27T23:59:01Z] req id=abcd1234 tokens_charged=560
[2026-02-27T23:59:02Z] req id=abcd1234 tokens_charged=560 (retry)
```
maya: if retries aren't de-duped at billing layer, they can burn promo balance then TTL job expires promo and marks remaining 0
alex: confirm: promo_expiry job is scheduled as a single shard at midnight UTC; if token charges land while ledger writes are still pending we can end up double counting during roll-forward
liz: workaround: we've paused the expiry cron for affected accounts and manually restored 1000 promo credits to org-azure-921. We also issued a compensatory credit of 1500 tokens for the extra burn.
maya: did we notify the customer?
sam: yes, messaged them 5 mins ago and requested they avoid retries until we deploy fix. They're okay with temporary credits.
liz: next steps: noah to add idempotency enforcement at metering ingress, alex to make promo_expiry job multi-shard with final reconciliation pass, and maya to document support KB steps.
noah: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/482 — adds idempotency header check + dedupe window
alex: created ticket BILL-774: make expiry job idempotent + reconciliation
maya: support KB draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/support/promo-recovery — will add repro and steps
sam: closing this thread once PR deploys and customer confirms balance. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
credits-bot: action: compensatory-credit 1500 issued to org-azure-921 by alex
sam: confirmed by customer — balance shows 1500 promo + 0 invoice outstanding
